model.name: T-apply-flow: BY-INVITE Apply button + invite-request messages
model.description: BY-INVITE rooms: requester sends an invite-request message into the room carrying name+uuid; the room shows an Apply button (NOT join); request can be accepted -> requester joins. PUBLIC rooms keep the join button. Singular-chain by design.
